text: Its pendulum swung back and forth with a dull, heavy sound, and every hour the clock struck with a deep, strange note. <break time="0.8s" /> The sound was so loud and peculiar that the musicians had to stop playing, and the dancers stopped dancing. <break time="0.8s" /> For a moment the whole merry crowd was troubled, and even the wildest guests turned pale. <break time="0.8s" /> The older guests passed their hands over their foreheads as if they were lost in a confused dream. <break time="0.8s" /> When the echoes died away, light laughter spread through the rooms, and the musicians smiled at their own nervousness. <break time="0.8s" /> They whispered promises that they would not be so troubled the next time the clock struck. <break time="0.8s" /> But after sixty minutes, or three thousand six hundred seconds, the clock struck again, and everyone was troubled just as before. <break time="0.8s" /> Still, it was a lively party, for the prince loved bright colors and strange effects, and he had planned every decoration himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Some people would have thought that he was mad, but his followers felt sure that he was not. <break time="0.8s" /> The guests wore wild costumes and moved through the seven rooms like figures in a dream, until the clock struck once more.
